rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a standout detail, event, or period.

example.english: The highlight of this trip was watching fireworks from a boat at night.
example.traditional: 今次旅行最有睇頭嘅亮點係夜晚坐船睇煙花。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 leoi5 hang4 zeoi3 jau5 tai2 tau4 ge3 loeng6 dim2 hai6 je6 maan5 co5 syun4 tai2 jin1 faa1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for emphasizing a point, fact, or feature rather than marking text or dyeing hair.

example.english: I want to highlight this point.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 koeng4 diu6 ni1 dim2

rows.note: Use this for marking important words or passages on paper, typically with a highlighter, and sometimes on screen.

example.english: Highlight these few sentences for me; I’ll use them to study later.
example.traditional: 你幫我畫低呢幾句，遲啲溫書用。
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 waa2 dai1 ni1 gei2 geoi3 ci4 di1 wan1 syu1 jung6

rows.note: Use this for contrasting dyed strands or patches of hair, especially in salon talk.

example.english: I want one or two highlight streaks, nothing too dramatic.
example.traditional: 我想整一兩條挑染，唔好太誇張。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zing2 jat1 loeng5 tiu4 tiu1 jim5 m4 hou2 taai3 kwaa1 zoeng1

rows.note: Use this technical visual-media term for a strongly lit area in an image or painting, not for a figurative standout feature.

example.english: The highlight area on the face in this photo is blown out, so all the detail is gone.
example.traditional: 呢張相塊面嘅高光位爆晒，細節都冇晒。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 faai3 min6 ge3 gou1 gwong1 wai6 baau3 saai3 sai3 zit3 dou1 mou5 saai3

rows.note: Use this specifically for dyeing selected strands of hair a different colour from the rest.

example.english: I want to highlight a few strands of my hair, not dye my whole head.
example.traditional: 我想挑染幾撮頭髮，唔使成頭染。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 tiu1 jim5 gei2 cyut3 tau4 faat3 m4 sai2 seng4 tau4 jim5
